hypothesis: Frozen four-weight learned testimony trust model can select and activate relevant alias-graph links among three conflicting, order-shuffled in-state candidate identity claims and beat fixed-first/always-all/no-link controls on unseen graph identities.

cohort.truth_variants: eight learned witness authorization counterfactuals plus intact, wrong claimant, double necessary role break and benign noise

architecture.learned_weights: Exact frozen W-F21 logistic 4-weights; no training, 576 byte state
architecture.in_state_claims: three candidate endpoint pairs and their three evidence channels in resident 576B words [24..35]
architecture.coded_parts: External source supplies candidate endpoint PAIRS; inference matches those candidate IDs to graph endpoints with equality, so does NOT discover candidates autonomously
architecture.candidate_inference: Frozen learned evidence policy decides which of three proposals can contribute to recurrent similarity matrix, no graph canonicalization

controls: learned evidence for all 3 shuffled claims
